# Vendored okf validator

`okf_validate.py` is copied unchanged from okf-skills 0.10.1
(https://github.com/scaccogatto/okf-skills, `skills/validate/scripts/`),
MIT licence, with its `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`. Tests run it in strict mode to
check that what kmctl writes is OKF v0.2 conformant. It is test-only: the
plugin gets OKF authoring from the okf plugin dependency (ADR 0003).
